question: What supreme attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: A practitioner may attain great accomplishment
This accomplishment includes enjoyment and liberation
Such attainment brings favor from yoginīs
inference: The great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation makes one dear to the yoginīs
plain_english: One may attain the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation and become dear to the yoginīs.
